title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee
summary: Given an array of stock prices where each element represents the price of a stock on a particular day, and an integer transaction fee, determine the maximum profit you can achieve.
statement: Given an array of stock prices where each element represents the price of a stock on a particular day, and an integer transaction fee, determine the maximum profit you can achieve. You can perform as many buy and sell transactions as you like, but you must pay the transaction fee for each transaction. Ensure that you do not engage in multiple transactions at the same time and that the transaction fee is only applied once per stock purchase and sale.
constraints: 1 <= len(prices) <= 50,000; prices are positive and fee is nonnegative.
Hold at most one share; pay the fee per completed transaction and maximize final profit.
reference_solution:
def stock_profit_with_fee(prices, fee):
    cash=0;holding=-prices[0]
    for price in prices[1:]:
        old_cash=cash
        cash=max(cash,holding+price-fee)
        holding=max(holding,old_cash-price)
    return cash
hints: After each day, only the best cash state and best one-share state matter.
Update cash by selling and holding by buying or keeping.
Any longer history ending in the same holding status is dominated by the one with greater profit.
editorial: Any longer history ending in the same holding status is dominated by the one with greater profit.

tests.explanation: Buying at one and four, then selling at eight and nine, yields eight after fees.
One combined transaction from one to ten yields six.
